newsitem.title: USA: ISP Holdings Inc places $325 mln notes due 2003.
newsitem.headline: ISP Holdings Inc places $325 mln notes due 2003.

text.p: ISP Holdings Inc on Friday said it completed a private placement of $325 million nine percent senior notes due 2003.
ISP is a wholly-owned subsidiary of GAF Corporation.
The issue, increased in size from $250 million to $325 million, was priced at a spread of 262.5 basis points over Treasuries to yield 9.055 percent. The notes are non-callable for three years.

ISP also said it completed its tender for senior discount notes due 1998 and Series B senior discount notes due 1998 of its wholly-owned subsidiary, G-I Holdings Inc and the private placement exchange for G-I Holdings' 10 percent senior notes due 2006.

The tender by ISP for $434.9 million of G-I Holdings' senior discount notes was completed with more than 98 percent of outstanding bonds tendered, the company said. The notes were issued in October 1993 to yield 11-1/8 percent.

The private placement exchange of ISP's $200 million 9-3/4 percent senior notes due 2002 for G-I Holdings' 10 percent senior notes due 2006 was completed with more than 99 percent of outstanding 10 percent notes tendered.
